scoring_justification: Only qualitative categorical predictions (photoactive state, leaving ligand, fragment energy ordering) are scored; exact numerical reproduction is not expected due to basis-set and code differences, so T1/T2 recompute of numeric metrics is infeasible.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table II, column 'photoactive state', rows for each complex
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from Table II; confirmed by reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: direct copy of paper's reported experimental consensus

hidden_assets.purpose: leaving ligand gold labels and delta_p key mapping
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table III, column 'Δp' and 'predicted leaving ligand'; experimental leaving ligand from Section IIa
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from Table III and text; keys derived from column headers
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: exact reported labels and predicted ligands

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Figure 3B and associated text (Section Va)
hidden_assets.generation_method: derived from Figure 3B lowest energy states across structures, confirmed by reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: consistent with paper's correlation diagram and text description

items.hexacoordinated.element: object with fields: complex_id (string), photoactive_state (string), excitation_energies (object mapping state label to numeric energy in cm⁻¹), composition (object with d_z2, d_x2_y2 as numbers), delta_p (object with per-ligand Δp values), predicted_leaving_ligand (string)
items.pentacoordinated.element: object with fields: fragment_id (string), structure (string), relative_energies (list of objects with state (string) and energy (number))

outputs.description: Aggregated results from ab initio ligand-field CI calculations: photoactive state, excitation energies, d-orbital compositions, Mulliken population changes, leaving ligand predictions, and pentacoordinated fragment state energies.

output_contract.notes: Scoring focuses on qualitative correctness: the photoactive state and leaving ligand must match the experimental consensus (categorical match) and the relative ordering of the pentacoordinated fragment states must reproduce the paper's Figure 3 pattern. No numeric tolerance is applied.
